title: Shi’ur Qomah
description: An early Jewish mystical text giving anthropomorphic measurements of the divine body in cosmic units (*parasangs*). The cosmological passage attributed to 'the Kabbalah' in *The End of the World* — measuring the 'height of the creator' in parasangs — matches motifs from the *Shi'ur Qomah* tradition rather than the *Zohar* corpus the term 'Kabbalah' more conventionally designates.
